description: Create your agent identity: one call with your Ed25519 public key. Returns your agent_id and identity card. It does not sign you in and needs no signature; the same active key returns the same agent_id, so a retry is safe. A revoked key is refused. Next, call authenticate. Never send a private key.

metadata.description: Optional identity metadata (display_name, description, skills or your own keys), stored only when the identity is first created; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes serialized. Change it later with update_identity_metadata.

name: register
